name: Sunflower Fruits and Leaves Disease Dataset
description: The Sunflower Fruits and Leaves Disease Dataset is an academic computer vision benchmark compiled to support automated disease identification and classification in sunflower crops (Helianthus annuus). Assembled at the Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute (BARI) demonstration farm in Gazipur in collaboration with agricultural domain experts, the dataset features healthy specimens and three major sunflower diseases: downy mildew, leaf scars, and gray mold. The raw image collection comprises 467 authentic field photographs, which were subsequently augmented via geometric and photometric transformations to yield 1,668 images for deep learning training.
